kind: private FP32 row-parallel partial adapter (source only)

geometry.supported_shape_source: attention o_proj (8192/8) and MLP down_proj (27648/8), both to hidden 5120

api.install: install(candidate, runtime, kernel_dir, *, sequence_length=2043, expected_world_size=8, expected_layer_count=100, verify_sources=True, allow_stream_switch=False) -> RowFp32Adapter (enabled False)

enabled_path_order: original Half activation, sharded exactly like the native forward when input_is_parallel is False
Half packed to (K1, Mp, 16) with the 5 padded M rows kept exactly zero
verified R83 kernel: Half x Half -> FP32 accumulator -> FP32 GM (no Half partial)
FP32 output unpacked to (tokens, N) then reshaped to the native (M,N) or (1,M,N)
the layer's own group.all_reduce on the FP32 partial (dtype asserted and counted both sides)
optional FP32 bias (inactive: H3 row layers are bias-free)
invariants_checked_by_tests: candidate file, forward source and class source digests equal the pins
editing the candidate forward makes verification fail closed
Round83 kernel and runtime module files equal their pins
the pinned launcher library digest appears in the runtime module
the original forward really rounds before the collective (the defect being removed)
only (1024,5120) and (3456,5120) row geometries are accepted
only (M,K) and (1,M,K) activations with M == 2043 are accepted
output shape is (M,N) / (1,M,N), never a bare (N,)
padded M is ceil(2043/128)*128 = 2048 with 5 padding rows
logical data_ptr and storage_offset both participate in the weight signature
a _version bump changes the signature (mutated parameter fails closed)
install patches only the row class forward and starts disabled
disabled calls delegate to the captured original forward
enabled use before prime raises
uninstall restores the original forward and tolerates a third-party replacement
no module-scope torch/vllm import; importing the adapter loads no torch
no bfloat16, quantization API, subprocess/socket or clamping in the adapter
FP32 is asserted before and after the collective, before the single cast
the verified Round83 pack_a/pack_w/unpack_c helpers are reused, not reimplemented
the shared kernel dir is guarded by an flock and a torn spec file is repaired atomically
a cross-stream buffer reuse fails closed unless explicitly allowed
not_established: the adapter has never been imported on an NPU host in this task
the two kernels are not built here; the root prebuilds them
no numerics: the FP32-partial gain over the native rounded partial is unmeasured here
no timing: packing/unpacking/collective cost is unmeasured here
no full-encoder precision or speed claim
the FP32 bias branch is implemented but never exercised (H3 row layers have bias=False)
